content: Khazing cawtah hring
Macawtaco, Khri zong tah a pungsaw tah a tai-ingpaw hrakhei, naaning zong ma hapaw tai-ingnah khakhei a pachia my lo, zecawtamaw tatah ma hratei taithuinah a ingpaw cawh suanah chung lekhei ung beh.
A hringchung vytei pungsaw sua dunah cawtah cang lytah Khazing dunah hratah a hring hri tahnah a cang.

Lawki cawngsaw sahlo tei tua pawtah aa thingpaw he ziaza a chiahrupaw hohenah, zuruinah, zucheinah hming letah a nawngsenah, langsianah, pasihpadawh a chuipaw nono behnah sahlo lekhei cai sypui naa za hmang thah hrah kho.
Chahlynah aa tuapaw sahlo hrong letah naa tae khawh ly tih he ceh tah naa huivesaw paring sahlo cawh aa khuarawha ngetei ka, naa kongchia aa ca rei he.
Canghrasala mehring kha mehthi kha biacepah pawtah a mai paciapaw Khazing hme letah aa kong cawh aa rei ceingei a.

Macawtaco, a thi ciapaw sahlo khakhei zong thawngchawbia khah reipaw cang ka, ma pawsui co aaning cawh aa pungsaw khah aa tuasenah hratah biacepah aa cang khy taitah aa thlawpaw cawh Khazing khatah a hring khypaw a cang.
Hming vytei a changnah ning cawh a ne myca. Macawtaco thlaw naa chang khy nápawtah naa lungthing pavang seh la, ma le ma a hraipaking khypaw cang my lo.
Zezong navy tah pakheh le pakheh lung hmuisui tah a do la, zecawtamaw tatah donah taco suanah a hlupui khah a ngethai sah.
Phingze lytah pakheh le pakheh a tlungke my lo.
Pakheh cy tah aa hmuhpaw lahsong maikaw khah ming hringpaw bong nápawtah hmang he seh la, Khazing ningdonah khah zingchui teitah a phingphing tah hmang my lo.

Pakheh kheh tah bia a rei caco, Khazing bia tei a reipaw hratah rei seh. Pakheh kheh tah a rai a hre caco, Khazing tah thawzaang a pehpaw hratah hre seh la, maco Zisu Khri thongtah Khazing khah zezongpui letah reithai a cang a. Laisuinah le hmingtuakhynah cawh chaizaw tah chaizaw tai Ama khatah ung ky seh. Amen!
Khrisaw cang rawng tah tai-ingnah
Ka dopaw huivesaw sahlo, a sahpaw pasenah alaipui tah naa ing rawng takhei naa khuarawha kheh seh la, a ung bang lypaw hming sahlo zong naa cung letah a tlung leimei tatah zong pacang khe lo.
Khri a tai-ingnah lekhei naa tai-ing hrahnah cawtah khei a lawng hri my lo, ma pawsui co a rungnawnah khatah a lang tihtah naa lunglawngnah a laihlui a.
Khri a ming rawng tah zongte naa cang caco, bonghnang song na cang he ceh, zecawtamaw tatah rungnawnah Thlawpaw, Khazing Thlawpaw cawh naaning khatah a ung.
Naa tai-ing caco, lenongpaw le aa rupaw le chahlynah a phingphing a tuapaw le male kong letah a cahro a catipaw hratah cang khe lo.
Canghrasala Khrisaw naa cangnah rawng tah naa tai-ing caco, naa ningzeh kheh seh, Khri a ming khah naa kai cawtah Khazing khah reithai hri my lo.

Zecawtamaw tatah atoheh Khazing biacenah cai cawh cang ka, Khazing ingchungkho taitah patho cang ka, kaaning taitah pathopaw a cang caco, Khazing thawngchawbia a nge lypaw sahlo aa cawtah zemaw aa chuh sialia a?
Mataico Capathai tah,

content.text: “Mehding caw tahmai pachahnah hmuh a ru caco,
Khazing zetahmai a rei lypaw sahlo le mehsua sahlo cawh zekhatamaw aa cang tae a?”

content: a tah.
Macawtaco Khazing dunah hratah a tai-ingpaw sahlo taco, zingchuipaw aaning a Tuatu he khakhei a pei he seh la, hmingchaw khah tua lo leimei he seh.
